frozen_boundary_summary.evidence_level: Compare existing recorded hashes/flags/counters only. No new tensor rehash or backward instrumentation; zero-learning close records and unchanged guards support the frozen-execution claim.

workers.startup_scope: Model loading + common restoration + initial case setup, not pure model loading

zero_generation_review.interpretation: Failed during loading before any episode or model generation; no diagnostic was resampled. Original records and time are retained.

gpu_time.scope: Bound worker process intervals on assigned GPU, including load/CPU/boundaries/exit detection; not kernel time or utilization. Do not add episode-wall sums again.

timing.queue_scope: Waiting spans contain capacity/stability admission and polling; overlapping worker queues are not summed as elapsed experiment time. Original stopped run and later recovery are separate wall-clock intervals.

process_read_only_check.method: Read /proc/<recorded PID>/stat; compare start_ticks for worker identities when present. No signaling or GPU telemetry.

definitions.decisions: Per-episode shared budget records, including refused generation admission.
definitions.output_bearing_calls: Compact original_attempts with original_output_present=true; no replayed/retokenized text.
definitions.tokens: Sum recorded actual reported_usage from settled attempts. Tokens recur for repeated prompt input; not unique content or cached-token accounting.
definitions.budget_charged_tokens: Actual ledger charges, potentially conservative if usage uncertain; all uncertain counts here are reported separately.
definitions.technical_unknown_cost: org-r0-A3-s1 retains real cost and submitted=true while R=None; no raw acceptance result promotes it to a business success.
definitions.unstarted_cost: No episode or usage exists for org-r0-X3-s1/org-r0-F2-s1; raw fields remain null rather than invented records. Actual-spend sums cover 22 main cost records.
definitions.tests: Member-triggered run_tests attempts only, including failures; excludes control-parent fixed-delivery acceptance.
definitions.episode_time: Recorded collection time until result construction, not complete worker life; closing guard/serialization may occur outside.
definitions.quality: Known results use status=closed and integer R=0/1. None is preserved for technical unknown/unstarted and for all guided diagnostics.
definitions.limitations: No full 24-slot mean R while three main outcomes unavailable. No speedup or organizational benefit inferred from cost or worker duration.

organization_audit.scope: Read original 22 executed main trajectories and 2 guided probes; retain all 24 planned main slots. No measure rerun, model/GPU/test/acceptance/hash/probability operation.
